ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aarti Industries Limited reported strong unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, demonstrating significant year-on-year and sequential growth in both revenue and net profit. For the second quarter of FY27, standalone net revenue surged to 3,942 Crs (up from 2,085 Crs YoY) and net profit increased to 186 Crs (up from 101 Crs YoY), indicating robust operational performance. A key red flag is the incompleteness of the provided consolidated financial results table, preventing a comprehensive assessment of the group's overall performance.
